capabilitiesLabel: What Jarvis can do right now
emptyBody: The answer arrives as cards built from real artefacts, not as text.
error.no-api-key: Jarvis is unavailable: the model key is not set
error.no-fixture: No demo scene was recorded for this question
error.incomplete-stream: The answer stream ended before completion
error.timeout: The model did not answer in time
error.tool-failed: A tool could not compute the result
error.upstream: Jarvis is unavailable: the service is not answering
inputPlaceholder: Ask about the fund, a well, a rule or a scenario…
walk.label: Guided well walkthrough
walk.selectWell: Select a well in the console first.
walk.situationQuestion: Walk through well {well} at step {step} ({date}): what happened, and which recorded data supports it?
walk.constraintQuestion: Which constraints apply to well {well} at step {step} ({date}), and which were actually checked?
walk.decisionQuestion: Why was this decision made for well {well} at step {step} ({date})? Use the decision journal if recorded and separate fact from inference.
walk.resultQuestion: What was the measured result for well {well} at step {step} ({date})? Show the source and do not substitute a forecast for a measurement.
walk.acceptanceQuestion: Can the selected plan be accepted at step {step} for well {well} ({date})? Separate OPM status, eligibility, and missing checks.
warning.number-dropped: A number missing from the data was cut from the caption
warning.context-reference-unverified: A rule, well, step, or date reference missing from the data was removed
warning.tool-result-unverified: A claim that the requested tool succeeded was removed because its data was unavailable
warning.plan-status-conflict: A positive eligibility claim was removed because recorded validation marks this plan unsound
warning.decision-claim-unverified: An unsupported cause or optimality claim was removed; the journal records events but does not establish causality
warning.run-reference-unverified: A run identifier was removed because it is not present in this answer's evidence
warning.unknown: The answer arrived with a caveat
error.provider-rate-limit: The model provider rate limited the request; try again later
error.provider-server-error: The model provider returned a server error
error.provider-http-error: The model provider rejected the request
error.provider-unreachable: Could not reach the model provider
error.provider-timeout: The model provider did not respond in time
error.busy: Jarvis is handling the maximum number of requests; try again later
